headline: I prompt for the shot, not just the image.
intro: I treat prompts as production instructions. Before generating a scene, I establish its narrative purpose, subject, action, environment, composition, camera angle, lens feel, lighting, colour, texture and emotional tone. For motion, I specify subject movement, camera movement, timing, direction and what must remain stable. I use reference frames and continuity constraints to maintain character identity, wardrobe, product appearance and spatial logic.
process: My process is iterative: generate controlled alternatives, compare them against the storyboard, isolate errors, refine one variable at a time and select the strongest usable result. I look for anatomical errors, warped logos, inconsistent props, flicker, unnatural motion, continuity breaks and unintended text before footage enters the edit.
exampleLabel: Prompt example (illustrative, not a client asset)
example: Vertical product commercial; approved reference bottle on a clean stone counter; soft morning side light; close-up at eye level; slow controlled push-in; preserve label, cap and proportions; natural reflections; no extra text, no deformation or sudden camera changes. Adapt syntax and negative constraints to the selected model.
